description: Fixes the crash (KeyError on category values such as 'peter'): the DFS indexed the per-category candidate-permutation list by search LEVEL instead of by CATEGORY, so when the mention-ordered search order differed from the category order, dicts keyed by one category's values were stored under another category, and the table build then raised KeyError. The search now uses cands[ci]/fc[cj] with ci=order[lvl], and pair clues are looked up with tuple(sorted((ci,cj))). Incremental forward checking and the multi-solution '?' marking are unchanged. The t4 replay test now uses a training trajectory in
